capabilities: Decorate headings with numbering or custom strings based on level
Configure decorator mode, position, opacity and maximum recognized level
Enable or disable decoration per view and per note via properties
Exclude folders or note-name regexes with blocklists
Customize decorator styles with CSS classes and variables
disambiguation: It does not modify note content; decorations are display-only and applied on top of existing headings.
intentEvidence: This plugin supports optional decoration for reading view, editing view (Live Preview and Source mode), Outline, Quiet Outline and Headings in Explorer plugin.
problem: Obsidian headings have no built-in numbering or visual level indicators, so document hierarchy is hard to see at a glance in views and outline panels.

relations.evidence: Enabled in outline plugin: Allow to decorate the heading under the Outline plugin.
Enabled in "Quiet Outline" plugin: Allow to decorate the heading under the Quiet Outline plugin.
Enabled in "Headings in Explorer" plugin: Allow to decorate the heading under the Headings in Explorer plugin.

summary: Level-based heading decorator that displays numbering or custom text before or after headings across views.
